Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
Employer Profile 
 The company is at the forefront of enabling our customers’ digital transformation and new experience design-led business models. The Automation and Intelligence Team plays a crucial role in driving the growth and success across our Creative & Productivity and Experience Orchestration businesses. We do this by providing the critical systems, tools, and insights that our Sales and Post-Sales teams need to make our customers successful.
 We are looking for a skilled and experienced Data Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in building data pipelines using APIs, strong SQL proficiency, and experience with Databricks, Power BI, and cloud-based data platforms. The Data Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing data solutions to enable efficient data integration, analysis, and reporting.
 Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain data integration pipelines utilizing APIs to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into target systems.
Build robust SQL queries, stored procedures, and data transformation scripts for data manipulation and transformation tasks.
Leverage Databricks to build scalable data transformation workflows, manage large datasets, and drive advanced analytics using Python and Spark.
Utilize Power BI to create insightful reports, dashboards, and visualizations to provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
Monitor data systems’ performance and address any issues or anomalies to ensure smooth data flow and system stability.
 Requirements 
Proven experience working as a Data Engineer, with a focus on data integration and data pipeline development.
Solid understanding of data modeling, data warehousing concepts, and ETL processes.
Hands-on experience with Databricks and Python for data manipulation, transformation, and large-scale data processing.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms such as Azure or AWS .
Understanding of Agile software development and CI/CD methodologies.
Strong problem-solving, adaptability, and communication skills, fostering effective teamwork and collaboration with cross-functional teams and partners.
Participate in code reviews, be open to feedback, and support team growth.
 Nice to Have 
Experience with Snaplogic for data integration and pipeline orchestration.
Familiarity with Power Apps to enhance data accessibility and user experience.
 Education 
5+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
Degree in CS, IT, Statistics, or a related field; or equivalent experience in sophisticated data engineering.
